title: Inverse path size bound
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $P$ be a path specifying binary values at some of the $n$ coordinates, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer no greater than the number of coordinates specified by $P$. Then $2^{-\mathrm{length}(P)}\le 2^{-k}$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a path assigning binary values to some coordinates
